_comment: The one rule for 'is this usable as [users].admins?'. Read by BOTH src/company/manifest.rs's validator (via its test) and frontend/src/lib/company-setup.ts (adminEmailProblem). The host rule is deliberately LOOSE — normalize_email is trim+lowercase, and the only structural demand is an '@' — because it exists to stop an entry normalizing to something LoginIdentity::parse would misread, not to police what a mail server accepts. A console that applied a stricter regex would reject addresses the host would happily take, which is its own bug. Add a case here before changing either side.

cases.why: case and surrounding space are normalized away, not rejected
a plus tag is a real mailbox
the host does not demand a dot in the domain
the reported bug: a bare word is not an address
